# Orchya Tech Limited

> London-based consulting firm operating across seven practice areas: project consulting, tech people consulting, human capital consulting, digital & AI transformation, product development, training & certification, and events.

Orchya Tech Limited was incorporated on 05 August 2026 in England & Wales and is headquartered in London. It is founder-led by Mr Kiran Rangaiah Shashi (Director), an AI Architect with 18+ years in financial services technology, including nine years delivering enterprise AI and data platforms for a global wealth management bank, and recognition including a WealthTech Award in 2026.

## Company details

- Legal name: Orchya Tech Limited
- Incorporated: 05 August 2026
- Jurisdiction: England & Wales
- Registered office: 167-169 Great Portland Street, 5th Floor, London, W1W 5PF, United Kingdom
- Director: Mr Kiran Rangaiah Shashi
- Email: kiran@orchya.co.uk
- Phone: +44 7787 030982

## Practice areas

- **Project Consulting** — PMO design and set-up, programme and delivery leadership, governance and reporting frameworks, vendor and supplier management.
- **Tech People Consulting** — Contract and interim technical resourcing, permanent hire search for engineering leadership, technical vetting, workforce strategy.
- **Human Capital Consulting** — Organisational design and restructuring, workforce planning, HR operating model and transformation, leadership advisory.
- **Digital & AI Transformation** — Digital and AI strategy and roadmapping, applied AI and automation delivery, legacy modernisation, data operating model design.
- **Product Development** — Product strategy and discovery, MVP and platform engineering delivery, UX/UI and architecture support, launch and scale support.
- **Training & Certification** — Technical bootcamps and upskilling programmes, certification pathway design, corporate learning partnerships.
- **Events** — Executive roundtables and briefings, industry and community meetups, panel and speaker programme curation.
